{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Count rows with sentinel age (-1)
num_sentinel = (sales['customer_age'] == -1).sum()

# Compute mean age on valid data (excluding -1)
valid_age_data = sales[sales['customer_age'] != -1]
mean_age = valid_age_data['customer_age'].mean()

# Print the required numbers
print(f'Number of rows with customer_age == -1: {num_sentinel}')
print(f'Mean age (excluding -1): {mean_age:.2f}')"}
